messages:
Asha: quick async standup — model onboarding + evals check
Asha: yesterday: finished conversion + smoke runs for `redwood-mini-7b-q4` on dedicated infra, pushed model bundle to staging. Added a small prompt set for billing-summary flows.
Asha: blockers: seeing a subtle quality dip on long receipts (>1k tokens) vs prod 13B baseline, need help triaging eval outputs.
Asha: today: run focused evals for the long-receipt prompt set, capture examples for SRE + QA; will open PR for rollout gating. pinging @Riley for prompt review.

Mateo: thanks — saw the bundle. can you paste the eval command you ran? will try to reproduce locally.

Asha: sure — command I used:
```
python -m evals.run 
  --model redwood-mini-7b-q4 
  --tasks prompt_sets/billing_summary_v2.jsonl 
  --out results/mini-q4-billing.jsonl 
  --batch 8 
  --max-seq 2048
```

Riley: will review prompt set now. quick note: I added a negative-case where invoices include nested tables — the model seems to hallucinate totals there.

Devin: I ran a diff against baseline on a quick subset — primary regression is in the "total_extraction" metric (F1 drop ~0.12). attaching sample: 

Devin: ```
input_id: 2431
expected: {"total": "$1,250.00"}
mini-q4: {"total": "$1,250.00"}
13b-baseline: {"total": "$1,250.00"}
mini-q4 (alt prompt): {"total": "$1,250.00 (approx)"}  # borderline formatting/hallucination
```

Priya: thanks for the sample. could be tokenization/float formatting from quantized LM. can you dump logits or confidence for those tokens?

Asha: will instrument a run that saves token probs for the extraction span. that should tell us if model is uncertain vs wrong parsing.

Mateo: I can spare GPU slot tonight to run full billing set with token probs. @eval-bot can you trigger a run queue for job 2026-03-billing-02?

eval-bot: queued job 2026-03-billing-02 on pool "staging-gpu-2" — est runtime 45m. you will get a thread update when done.

Riley: on prompt side, I proposed two edits to billing_summary_v2: (1) stricter instruction for numeric normalization, (2) add explicit example of nested table parsing. small diff PR incoming.

Asha: great — I'll hold on the rollout PR until we have token-prob traces + Riley's prompt tweaks.

Devin: quick ask: PR #487 (bundle + config) needs a reviewer — @Priya can you glance at the quant config? it's just a knob check but want a second pair of eyes.

Priya: will review in the next hour. if all good, we can run a canary with 10% traffic on dedicated tomorrow.

Mateo: FYI I noticed latency tail on the staging bundle at seq>1500 — adding an instrumentation ticket in backlog (ENG-ML-321). not blocking the evals but worth tracking.

Asha: thanks all. summary: running token-prob eval tonight (Mateo), Riley will update prompt set, Priya reviews PR, hold rollout until traces + prompt fixes.

Riley: one more — if token-probs look noisy, we can try per-span re-ranking with 13B as oracle for numeric fields (cheap hack) while we debug.

Asha: good idea — keep that as fallback plan. will update this thread with results when eval-bot finishes. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: job 2026-03-billing-02 completed — results uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/evals/2026-03-billing-02/results.jsonl (20m).

Mateo: got the artifact, starting analysis now. I'll post a small summary + top 10 failure cases in here once done.

Priya: thanks team. I'll queue canary gating checklist but won't enable rollout until we have actionable next steps.

Devin: done for today. ping me if you want me to run any targeted synthetic tests on nested tables.

Asha: awesome, that's all from me.
